demonstration_passes.note: Live testnet transactions of the two demonstration passes, replayed on 2026-10-16 AFTER the LayerZero pathway was pinned (see 'wiring'), each between two named demonstration VASPs. This is data, not a reproducibility claim; it is replayed by scripts/demo/corridor-fx-e2e.mjs, which reads each receipt on the public RPC and renders its state. Both arrival transactions carry EVM status success: the refusal is semantic (the composer rolls the swap back and keeps the value in transit), not a reverted transaction. Party names (BANK FR, BANK SG1, BANK SG2) are demonstration labels for identified financial institutions, not central bank entities.

routes.note: The arrival composer knows two exchange routes, FIXED in the contract. The compose payload is beneficiary(20) ++ minOut(32) ++ route(1) ++ attestedOut(32) ++ attestation. attestedOut is the SGDX amount the quote attested; the composer delivers EXACTLY attestedOut to the beneficiary, keeps any surplus the swap produced above it, and the operator can sweep that surplus to a sink fixed at construction. A read-only route agent quotes both routes on the chain and picks the higher SGDX output (tie: direct); the contract only accepts a route identifier, and minOut applies to the final SGDX, so a wrong choice can only make the whole call fail. All three pools hold base tokens, never wrappers; compliance applies to the transfer of the wrapped SGDX.
